available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type to be used in PCM modeling

region.description: Location where the component applies. Can be a zone or node.

financial_data.description: Struct containing relevant financial information for a technology

capital_costs_solar.description: Capital costs for investing in a technology. Units: USD/MW

lifetime_solar.description: Maximum number of years a technology can be active once installed (years). Units: yr

capital_costs_wind.description: Capital costs for investing in a technology. Units: USD/MW

capacity_limits_wind.description: Maximum allowable installed capacity for a technology. Units: MW

lifetime_wind.description: Maximum number of years a technology can be active once installed (years). Units: yr

capital_costs_energy.description: Capital costs for investing in a storage technology's energy capacity. Units: USD/MWh

capital_costs_power.description: Capital costs for investing in a storage technology's charge/discharge capacity. Units: USD/MW

operation_costs_energy.description: Fixed and variable O&M costs for a storage technology. Units: USD/MWh

operation_costs_power.description: Fixed and variable O&M costs for a storage technology. Units: USD/MWh

requirements.description: List of requirement IDs associated with the component
